stemMd: What is the distance between (−1, −2) and (5, 6)?
explanationMd: The coordinate differences are six and eight. By Pythagoras the distance is √(6² + 8²) = √100 = 10. The result is the hypotenuse of the right triangle formed by the horizontal and vertical changes.

distractorRationale.d: This adds coordinate changes rather than using Euclidean distance.
distractorRationale.c: This fails to square the differences.
